integrity_issues: The paper's bibliography had Adel et al. 2024 author first names wrong (Wes, Saeed for Wesley, Salma) and no DOI; fixed from the NSF public-access record.
The data set's AdaptivePose.csv does not reproduce the source paper's Table 1 (mean 1.956 vs 0.401 mm); recorded and not used. BenchmarkPose.csv reproduces it exactly.

doc_friction.issue: Data hosts: the Princeton Data Commons landing page is behind a bot challenge, but its catalog .json endpoint lists Globus direct-download URLs that work through the proxy; worth a line under 'Outbound hosts'.
Harness blocks 'sleep N; cat file' waits; pyenv.py background job plus the task-notification was the working pattern (already documented, cost one retry).

deviations.why: H52 was registered on 'the measured shapes'; the raw slices carry 2 mm scan quantisation, so the headline uses a 110 mm running mean and a post hoc variant with the cross-member common part removed, both reported beside the raw result.
deviations.did: Reported raw, smoothed and common-removed variants; scored H52 on the smoothed one as the closest to the registered intent.
deviations.result: H52 refuted in every variant (11-20 points), so the choice does not change the verdict.

deviations.why: Plate profiles were planned as 'also reported'; the plates' inner edge is coplanar with the stud ends so a slice cannot separate them.
deviations.did: Dropped plate profiles and said why in extract.py.

notes: Research track, programme buildbot-sheathing, milestone 11: first measured studs, from the Adel et al. 2024 laser scan of a robot-built 2x4 wall (CC BY 4.0). Pre-registered H49-H52: H50 held, H49/H51/H52 refuted. Single 2x on measured shapes 0.425-0.471 vs 0.579 for parabolas at the same bows; doubled joints 1.000. Local checks: pytest 59 passed 8 skipped; paper/check_numbers.py 113/113; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links ok; cite_check ok (both Adel DOIs); post frontmatter ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a researcher locating the data set, writing the point-cloud extractor and calibration, rerunning the Monte Carlo and writing it up: about two working days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
